gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Wide-open and nib-drawn, Stentiga looks luxurious at once. But Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line height with open terminals, so a long passage would read in a clear, contemporary way.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Stentiga spaces out its refined letters, with diagonals that match the stems in thickness. A long passage in Noto Sans Hebrew would feel modern, its big midsection filling the line.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-hk: Refined and widely tracked, Stentiga never mixes bold-looking and light-looking strokes within a word. Noto Sans HK follows with large lowercase forms and brush ends lifted before each curve closes, so the sans body feels clean beneath it.
